message: Found usage of eval()/exec()/system() in main.cpp. Note: Flagged as High Severity injection vulnerability.
Source files are placed in root.
Project lacks a dedicated tests directory.
Project has neither requirements.txt nor package.json.
Project lacks an example environment variables file.
`system()` executes a shell command or a new process. Passing attacker-controlled data leads to OS command injection (CWE-78). Validate all inputs; prefer safer alternatives where available.
